title: Cyberparadism Manifesto
description:
The Cyberparadism Manifesto, first published on GitHub in April 2023 (Laws and Signs added in May 2023, resources section in November 2023) and maintained since 2026 in a lightly copyedited edition on the aesthetic's website, outlines a vision for a future shaped by the positive potential of technology and scientific progress. At its core, Cyberparadism focuses on using technology to enhance the human experience, promote sustainability, and foster a collective sense of purpose and responsibility. It is not a political or economic manifesto, but rather an aesthetic declaration that seeks to inspire and stimulate imagination. The manifesto embraces the idea that technology can create a world of abundance, equity, and harmony with nature. It promotes values such as ingenuity, continuity, and siblinghood and emphasizes the responsible use of technology to create a better world. Cyberparadism is seen as a pathway to a future where technology and nature coexist harmoniously, enhancing rather than detracting from the natural world​​.
